codeReview.summary: The implementation fully satisfies the feature requirements. All 6 specified test cases were added with comprehensive coverage: gamma correction formula validation with factor 1.45, perceptually uniform midtone brightening, edge case handling (0.0, 1.0), monotonic property validation, output range validation, and inverse function correctness. The tests are well-structured with clear assertions and good documentation.
